t: This is Harewood Avenue, a street in the City of Westminster. It takes its name from Emma Portman, Viscountess Portman, a British aristocrat who lived from 1809 to 1865. She was the daughter of Henry Lascelles, the 2nd Earl of Harewood, and Henrietta Sebright, and the Harewood name comes from her father's title. The street, in other words, carries a family name rather than a place name, and it recalls her family connection.
